# Overview

Proteins fold into three-dimensional shapes determined by their amino acid sequence. The shape decides what the protein does in the cell.

## Structure prediction

AlphaFold predicts a protein structure from its sequence. It uses multiple sequence alignments of related proteins and an attention-based network called the Evoformer. Predictions come with a confidence score (pLDDT) for each residue.

## Open questions

Intrinsically disordered regions don't have one stable fold, so predicted structures there are unreliable.
